new_packages.label: כַּנְפֵי רֵאָה, יָדַיִם וְהַדִּבּוּר
new_packages.label_en: The Lung-Wings, Hands, and the Faculty of Speech
new_packages.rationale: Torah #45 opens with an explicit bechina cluster about the physical anatomy of speech. The Rebbe states: 'נִתְעוֹרְרִים בְּחִינַת כְּנָפַיִם' — the hands awaken the bechina of wings; then 'הַיְנוּ כַּנְפֵי רֵאָה' (= the lung-wings); then 'שֶׁמִּשָּׁם נִתְהַוֶּה הַדִּבּוּר' (from there comes speech). The three bechina markers are: (1) 'בְּחִינַת כְּנָפַיִם' — wings is a bechina; (2) 'הַיְנוּ' — the standard Rebbe Nachman equivalence gloss making כנפים = כנפי ראה; (3) the empirical confirmation 'וְכָל זֶה אָנוּ רוֹאִים בְּחוּשׁ, שֶׁהַיָּדַיִם הֵם כְּנֶגֶד כַּנְפֵי רֵאָה' — we see empirically that the hands ARE opposite the lung-wings. The bechina chain in this cluster: ידיים ↔ כנפים ↔ כנפי ראה ↔ דיבור. These four concepts share a single essential nature: they are all expressions of the physical infrastructure of divine speech — the wing-hand-lung complex that is the body's speech-production apparatus. The hands are the external form of what the lung-wings are internally; clapping (מחאת כפים) awakens this structure. The halakhic proof-text clinches the anatomical bechina: if the wing-stump (גף) breaks near the body, the lung is certainly perforated — proving the hands/wings share the same structural identity. Polarity: neutral. The wings of the lung and the hands are anatomical structures — body parts — that can serve speech of holiness (good) or remain dormant or serve other purposes. The teaching activates them for holy prayer-speech, but their intrinsic nature is neutral (physical instrument). This distinguishes NP-1 from NP-2: NP-1 is the physical/anatomical dimension; NP-2 is the spiritual/Binah/liberation dimension.

bechina_evidence.note: הַיְנוּ is Rebbe Nachman's standard equivalence marker — 'that is to say' = these are the same thing
The lung-wings are the source of speech — they are the same reality viewed as container (lung-wings) vs. content/output (speech)

bechina_evidence.statement: וְכָל זֶה אָנוּ רוֹאִים בְּחוּשׁ, שֶׁהַיָּדַיִם הֵם כְּנֶגֶד כַּנְפֵי רֵאָה

bechina_evidence.source: line 1 of torah_45.txt — proof-text from Ezekiel 10
bechina_evidence.note: Scripture places hands UNDER wings — hands and wings are the same structural pair: the external manifestation (hand) under the internal wing

new_packages.structural_note: New Package 1 is the PHYSICAL SUBSTRATE cluster of Torah #45's teaching. Its domain is: the body's speech-apparatus — hands, wings, lung, speech. The three eitza edges in the dataset (1512, 2478, 3022) all FLOW FROM this cluster: clapping the hands (which ARE the lung-wings) →eitza→ produces the bechina of מי (50/Binah) →eitza→ forms the mouth (פה). The direction is: NP-1 (physical substrate of speech) →eitza→ NP-2 (spiritual dimension of speech / liberation-through-Binah). NP-1 is neutral polarity because it is the neutral physical instrument; the spiritual transformation occurs at the interface with NP-2.

new_packages.label: מִי, חֲמִשִּׁין שַׁעֲרֵי בִּינָה, פֶּה וּגְאֻלָּה
new_packages.label_en: The Name 'Mi', Fifty Gates of Binah, the Mouth, and Redemption
new_packages.rationale: Torah #45 contains a second, distinct bechina cluster about the SPIRITUAL DIMENSION of speech — its source in Binah, its realization as the mouth, and its liberation from exile. This cluster is built around four explicit bechina statements: (1) '50 (from clapping) IS a bechina of the 50 times Exodus is mentioned' — bְּחִינוֹת explicit; (2) 'through the bechina of Jubilee they left Egypt' — יוֹבֵל IS the 50/liberation dimension; (3) 'through the 50 gates of Binah the mouth was formed' — חמישין שערי בינה IS פה; (4) 'מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם — מִי דַּיְקָא' — the word מי (= 50, = Binah) IS the bechina-key, emphasized with דיקא (precisely this word). The cluster: 50 ↔ יובל ↔ חמישים פעמים יציאת מצרים ↔ חמישין שערי בינה ↔ מי ↔ פה ↔ גאולה. They all express one essential reality: the spiritual power of liberation-through-understanding that is embedded in the number 50 / the sefirah of Binah / the Divine name מי. The good pole of this cluster (מי/בינה/פה/גאולה) has an exact evil mirror embedded in the same text: גלות מצרים = דיבור בגלות = כבד פה. This evil mirror sub-cluster sits within NP-2 as the opposite polarity face of the same speech-liberation domain. The dominant node is מי — it is the pivot where all dimensions converge: arithmetic (50 = 5×5×2), historical (Jubilee/Exodus-50 mentions), sefirot (Binah = מי), and anatomical (מי שם פה = the mouth is the realization of מי). Polarity of the package as a whole: good (the teaching drives toward liberation, the good pole dominates — the evil mirror is named only to explain what was overcome).

כִּי עַל־יְדֵי בְּחִינוֹת יוֹבֵל יָצְאוּ מִגָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם
bechina_evidence.note: Jubilee IS the bechina-dimension through which Exodus happened

bechina_evidence.statement: נִמְצָא שֶׁעַל־יְדֵי חֲמִשִּׁין שַׁעֲרֵי בִּינָה נִתְהַוָּה הַפֶּה
bechina_evidence.note: Formation = identity: the 50 gates of Binah IS what the mouth is

bechina_evidence.statement: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת (שמות ד): מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם – מִי דַּיְקָא
bechina_evidence.note: מי דיקא = specifically/precisely מי — the Rebbe's strongest emphasis that מי IS the bechina-key
Clapping produces the bechina of מי — confirms מי as a bechina-concept
Redemption forms the bechina of פה — גאולה and פה are the same spiritual event

bechina_evidence.statement: וְעִקַּר גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם, שֶׁהָיָה הַדִּבּוּר בְּגָלוּת
bechina_evidence.note: עיקר = essence = what something essentially IS. This is bechina-identity language: 'the essence of X is Y' = X is a bechina of Y

new_packages.structural_note: New Package 2 is the SPIRITUAL LIBERATION cluster of Torah #45. Its domain is: the number 50 / Binah / the Divine name מי / the mouth / redemption — all as different expressions of the single liberation-of-speech dimension. The evil mirror sub-cluster (גלות/דיבור בגלות/כבד פה) is the same domain seen from the captivity pole. The Torah's full teaching structure is: [Physical act: clapping hands (NP-1 mechanism: ידים = כנפי ראה)] →eitza→ [Spiritual production: 50 = מי = Binah (NP-2 dimension)] →eitza→ [Completion: פה (mouth formed — NP-2's culminating node) receives דיבור from NP-1] = full realization of prayer-speech. The path from evil to good within NP-2 is: גלות מצרים/דיבור בגלות →eitza→ גאולה/פה. The connection between NP-1 and NP-2 is through פה: NP-1 (כנפי ראה → דיבור) sends to NP-2 (פה receives the דיבור). The pivot node connecting both packages is the act of clapping (which activates NP-1's anatomy and produces NP-2's spiritual dimension simultaneously).

observations:
Torah #45 is the most extreme case of bechina-dataset sparsity encountered in this series: ZERO bechina edges exist in the dataset for this Torah, despite the text being dense with bechina language. The teaching is short (6 lines) but structurally complete, with two independent bechina clusters:

1. NP-1 (Lung-Wings/Hands/Speech): A neutral-polarity anatomical cluster. The Rebbe establishes the bechina identity of hands = wings = lung-wings = source-of-speech through three converging proofs: the bechina marker itself, the הינו-gloss, and empirical observation. This is unique in the Rebbe Nachman corpus as an 'empirical bechina' ('וכל זה אנו רואים בחוש'). 4 nodes.

2. NP-2 (מי/Binah/50/Mouth/Redemption): A good-polarity liberation cluster with a built-in evil mirror. The Rebbe establishes a 7-node bechina chain: 50 = יובל = חמישים פעמים יציאת מצרים = חמישין שערי בינה = מי = פה = גאולה, with its evil mirror: גלות מצרים = דיבור בגלות = כבד פה. The pivot node is מי, emphasized with דיקא. 10 nodes (7 good + 3 evil mirror).

Both packages easily exceed the 3+ bechina-language concepts threshold. Together they form a complete two-package structure with one eitza flow between them: NP-1 (physical substrate) →eitza→ NP-2 (spiritual realization). This matches the Torah's own structure: clapping is described → anatomical reason explained (NP-1) → spiritual-numerical reason explained (NP-2) → combined result: prayer-speech restored.
note_on_moshe_kebad_peh: Moses (משה) appears in the text only as the carrier of the 'heavy mouth' bechina — he IS כְּבַד פֶּה in this Torah's context. He is not a separate node; he exemplifies the evil-mirror state of דיבור בגלות. His name need not be a separate node — the teaching uses him illustratively, not as an independent bechina term.
note_on_six_line_structure: Despite being only 6 lines long, Torah #45 has a clean two-package structure mirroring the teaching's two-part argument: Part 1 (lines 1-2): What clapping does physically (NP-1 domain). Part 2 (lines 3-6): Why it works spiritually — the 50/Binah/מי/פה dimension (NP-2 domain). The summary-repetition in lines 5-6 confirms both packages are the complete teaching.
